extraction_notes: The paper reports surface-area-normalized 'Activity (µmol_C3H8·m^-2·s^-1)', calculated from propane consumption, not a propylene formation rate; it is stored in propylene_rate because no separate activity field exists, with the original unit retained. Propane conversion values are not reported for individual entries; the text only states catalytic-test conversions ranged between 2 and 10%, so individual conversion fields are left missing. Figure 4 panel a and Figure 7 panel a activity plots were not available/readable in the supplied images; Figure 4b selectivity records were extracted only for feed ratios not already represented more clearly in Fig. 5/Fig. 7. Figure 8b selectivity was not supplied/readable, so cycles 2–18 contain activity only. Values from bar charts and plots are approximate and marked with qualifier '~'.
